description: Speak with the Master Smith along at the top of Khabor's Pass. He has lived in these mountains his entire life and may know of a way to enter the Order Camp without having to knock on the gate.
name: Back Door (MSQ)
completed: The Master Smith has told you of a secret passage located inside a cave near Leisa Falls. Go to the cave that the hedge witch Tinny has taken over and find the passage.
